response.sql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT tif, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_s FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_s) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the mean of the per-bucket shares across all buckets (including the NULL time-in-force bucket), which equals 1/number of buckets.
Orders with NULL timespan form one bucket (GROUP BY groups NULLs together). Each riskandmargin row counts once; if an order has multiple risk records, each is counted.
If no bucket exceeds the average (all buckets equal), the result row contains NULLs.
